development: v5 smoke-v1: all six initial/final calibrated views
evaluation: v5 smoke-v2: all initial/final calibrated views, before inspecting detector outputs
partial_annotations: Independent offline amodal projection of task parcels only; one-to-one recall at IoU >=0.5, including occluded parcels; no whole-image precision metric

candidate_freeze.method: Four fixed 60%-width/height crops at the image corners, 20% overlap, same detector and thresholds, per-query score-ordered NMS at IoU 0.5
candidate_freeze.motivation: Whole-image development results miss all 12 small parcel boxes and report six false elephant boxes
candidate_freeze.evaluation_status: No smoke-v2 neural outputs have been generated or inspected
candidate_freeze.cost: Four neural forward passes per query instead of one; no privileged target crop
candidate_freeze.scope: All four queries use the identical crop strategy, including the absent elephant control

scope: Frozen pretrained language-conditioned RGB detection; measured depth gives visible-surface samples, never object centers or grasp poses. Offline replay study, no robot control.
negative_control: Elephant is absent; retain all detections as false positives, not silently filtered.
evaluation_limits: New views of a related simulation scenario, not independent real-world episodes
Query words do not prove arbitrary instruction following
Detection scores are not calibrated probabilities
Stable depth in a box can still belong to background; no segmentation or semantic depth guarantee
No success-rate or accuracy claims without independent annotations
All misses and depth abstentions retained
